messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "reason to stop"
set: ["reason to stop", "reason for taking it", "this is the reason for the recommendation", "not to stop it suddenly", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "decision to stop or continue sertraline", "stop taking", "ask doctor how to safely stop using", "stop taking medicine", "help stop smoking", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor", "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "stop taking this medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
